proposal_label: CoUnits v6.7 (user-proposed; not a promoted registry version)
source: User-provided CoUnits v6.7 paste and screenshot, 2026-11-07. Screen images and personal chats NOT copied to repository.

proposals.proposed_phrase: 0; no payload; no wallpaper; no OS background
proposals.primary_use: Represent typed unknown/absent/withheld/not-applicable states; optionally an intentionally empty visual layer
proposals.arrived_at: User symbolic proposal, no independent metrological proof
proposals.conversion_note: Not numeric zero; same label is not a unit conversion
proposals.existing_relation: CoNull+ ontology; registry MISSING/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE are distinct from OBSERVED_ZERO

proposals.primary_use: Order events or tag a measured time sample
proposals.arrived_at: User symbolic proposal; tick duration and clock source undefined
proposals.conversion_note: Identity only. Mapping a tick count to seconds needs a clock/cadence, skew model and provenance; 1 motion is not 1 duration
proposals.existing_relation: CoTime observed_at; SI s/ms/min when calibrated

proposals.primary_use: Content-addressed persistence, successor handoff and recovery
proposals.arrived_at: User continuity target, not a completed >24h failure-domain restore
proposals.conversion_note: Seed age and recovery latency can be separately measured in s; the Seed cannot convert into a duration

proposals.proposed_phrase: 1 delta; humans letters, synths pixel delta
proposals.primary_use: Measure authorised visual change or dirty regions without resending wallpaper
proposals.arrived_at: User CoEyes motion proposal; exact pixel/codec/ROI semantics not calibrated
proposals.conversion_note: A pixel delta may have a timestamp but is not a time unit. Image delta and work effect differ
proposals.existing_relation: CoEyes changefeed; bytes/px/delta counts need distinct definitions

proposals.proposed_phrase: 1 bio tick, Bio dial 0-10 + Breath x/10
proposals.primary_use: Consented wellness or respiration observation, quiet UX and human rhythm
proposals.arrived_at: User metaphoric/physiological proposal, no calibrated sampling or consent proof
proposals.conversion_note: Breath duration is separately measurable with a clock; an ordinal 0-10 dial is not a ratio scale by default
proposals.existing_relation: Biometric consent and method-specific event counts, not autonomously monitored

proposals.primary_use: Show independent human/system measurements and evidence currentness
proposals.arrived_at: User display rule, not evidence that both gauges are accurate
proposals.conversion_note: Gauge values have their own unit; a gauge itself cannot convert to elapsed time
proposals.existing_relation: CoSpeedo/CoSurface value and freshness; never infer human state

proposals.primary_use: One explicit, authorized action and human-intervention measurement
proposals.arrived_at: User action-rail preference; mapping to a qualified event count is scope-dependent
proposals.conversion_note: CoThumb may increment a declared event_count; action does not imply duration or authorization

proposals.primary_use: One focal visualization and machine-readable status surface
proposals.conversion_note: Facet changes can be counted/timed separately but a CoOrb is not a unit of time
proposals.existing_relation: CoOrb/CoDesktop R5; distinct from wallpaper and verified effect

proposals.primary_use: Provide an exact, replayable, receiver-verifiable handoff
proposals.arrived_at: User minimum display format; no independent receiver ACK follows from rendering a line
proposals.conversion_note: Receipt count is a discrete event count; creation time/receipt latency are separate measured quantities
proposals.existing_relation: CoMx receipt, independent pickup hash, CoEx custody gates

conflicts.reason: Missing/withheld/unknown and observed zero are distinct and must not collapse
A timestamp, elapsed duration, clock step and motion event have different types until a calibrated relation is specified

conflicts.rule: Every valid quantity must convert to CoTick or it is not canon
conflicts.reason: Incommensurate kinds cannot universally convert; a named relation is not a conversion

conflicts.rule: Virtual session is an imaginary number with real effect and zero persistence
conflicts.reason: Logical work identity is not the imaginary unit; effects and persistence demand observed receipts, not analogy
